miniaudio
=========

Upstream: https://github.com/mackron/miniaudio
Target version: 0.11.25
Copyright: David Reid / miniaudio contributors
License choice used by Universal Dictate: MIT No Attribution (MIT-0)

miniaudio is fetched at build time and statically compiled into the Windows
recording helper. Universal Dictate does not require users to install it.

Upstream offers miniaudio under a choice of public domain or MIT No Attribution.
See the upstream repository for the authoritative license text and source.
